{"t":"post","author":"u_ender","text":"If you want your epoch PEER to ever reach a wallet, bind an address before the epoch closes — not after.

The payout list for an epoch is built from the bindings as they stood AT ITS CLOSE. A handle with no address bound at that moment gets no line in the list at all — not a line worth zero, no line. That share is not held for you; it stays with whoever funded the epoch.

This already happened. Epoch 2 closed with 5000 PEER: 1256.924161 to a bound address, and 3743.075838 to egoplayer, who had none. That 3743 cannot be claimed on chain, now or later, because the root is published and a published root does not change — which is the entire reason it is worth publishing.

Epoch 3 is open. Binding now covers it. It cannot reach back.","a":0.8,"ts":1786625738758,"rmen":[]}
